# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2017

**2017 Revised Revenue Code of the Municipality of Pitogo in Relation to RA 7160**

Resolution No. 140

## Summary

Comprehensive 97-page revised revenue code of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. References [[Sec-129-RA7160]] (Title I, Book II of RA 7160) and its Implementing Rules and Regulations. Covers all local taxes, fees, charges, and revenue measures of the municipality. Updates and supersedes the previous Municipal Tax Ordinance No. 01 enacted by the Nalo Council. This is the foundational revenue code -- many subsequent ordinances reference it.

Motioned by [[Esperanza A. Tan]], seconded by [[Joselito L. Jaranilla]], [[Adam M. Forbes]], [[Rubi A. De Asis]], and [[Timoteo F. Villaflor Jr.]]

## Key Provisions

- **Scope:** All local taxes, fees, charges, and revenue measures for the Municipality of Pitogo
- **Legal Framework:** Based on Sections 129-155 and Section 186 of RA 7160 (Local Government Code)
- **Coverage:** Business taxes, real property taxes, fees and charges, community tax, and other revenue measures
- **Repeals:** Previous Municipal Tax Ordinance No. 01 enacted during the Nalo Council
- **Foundational ordinance** referenced by many subsequent fiscal ordinances

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-129-RA7160]] through [[Sec-155-RA7160]] — Local taxation provisions (Title I, Book II)
- [[Sec-186-RA7160]] — Power to levy other taxes, fees, or charges
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
- Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 7160
